description: rc.8 (F-05): the number rule is closed under the canonical form. A literal whose value is an integer of magnitude greater than 2^53 and less than 10^21 is invalid however it is written (here 9.007199254740994e15): a double keeps 2^53+2 exactly, but RFC 8785 writes it as the integer literal 9007199254740994, which the same rule refuses, so a valid document could otherwise have an invalid canonical form.

errors: /x-n: integer value 9.007199254740994e15 is outside ±2^53 and below 10^21 (not representable in canonical form)
/x-n: integer value 9.007199254740994e15 is outside ±2^53 and below 10^21 (not representable in canonical form)
